card.name: "in the" before a rough quantity
card.fires_on: The word "the" (or "in", "low", "mere") right after "in" or "into" when a rough size or range comes next, such as hundreds, millions, or "the range of".

modes.label: Approximate magnitude
modes.description: "in the" before hundreds, thousands, or millions when giving a rough count or cost.
modes.example: Kivalina and Savoonga are among a few dozen other settlements, mostly Alaska Native villages with populations in<< the>> hundreds.

modes.label: Value range
modes.description: "in the" before "range" or a band of values such as a lab level or dose.
modes.example: ZELAPAR is achieved only at doses in<< the>> range recommended for the treatment of Parkinson’s

card.writes: It promotes rough-magnitude words like hundreds, thousands, dozens, and "-sized".
card.plain: It marks the spot after "in the" where a rough amount like hundreds or millions is about to be named.
